name: NoodleCSS
description: NoodleCSS is a lightweight and flexible CSS framework that provides a set of pre-designed components and utilities for building responsive web interfaces. It is designed to be easy to use and customize, making it a great choice for developers looking to quickly create modern web applications.

name: LightVM
description: LightVM is a lightweight virtual machine that allows developers to run and test their code in a secure and isolated environment. It supports multiple programming languages and provides a simple interface for managing virtual machines.
